issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() as returning String, but the intended/implemented API in the solution uses an int return type. This discrepancy will confuse students: the instructions tell them to check the UML for the expected return type, so some students may implement a String-returning method (failing tests or conflicting with the reference implementation) while the solution and typical numeric logic expect an int.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the UML and any textual references in problem_statement.md to indicate getTotalNumberOfStudents() returns int (not String). Alternatively, if a String return type was intended, change the solution and template to declare and implement getTotalNumberOfStudents() returning String. The preferred fix is to make the UML return type int to match the numeric semantics and the solution implementation.
